artist_notes.name: Neeko
artist_notes.note: Resident selector for Sunday Sessions LA, the vinyl-only series at Apotheke — all-wax house and disco.

artist_notes.name: Krane
artist_notes.note: Longtime Sunday Sessions LA resident — vinyl-only house DJ recorded across the series' open-air sets.

cc5a11b4ddb8.curator_note: Sunday Sessions is one of the bigger vinyl-only crews in the country, and this is their open-air Apotheke session — exactly the all-wax, no-laptop house you want closing out a solstice Sunday. Low-key but the real deal.
cc5a11b4ddb8.description: Sunday Sessions LA vinyl-only open-air house session at Apotheke with residents Neeko and Krane, from 6pm.

5dcdfc5a574d.curator_note: Bill Duke was in the cast, which is why Vidiots slots 'Predator' into his weekend — and a 35mm print of the 1987 jungle classic is the right way to see it. Already sold out, so it's a 'if you have a ticket' note.
5dcdfc5a574d.description: John McTiernan's 'Predator' (1987, 107 min) on 35mm at Vidiots in Eagle Rock, 3:30pm, as part of the Bill Duke weekend — SOLD OUT.

404a1190c380.title: Chris Lake (18+) - Saturday

artist_notes.name: Chris Lake
artist_notes.note: British-born, LA-based DJ/producer whose Black Book Records output — slippery, groove-heavy tech-house with a dark edge — has made him one of the defining figures of the current moment in American club music.

artist_notes.name: Hot Since 82
artist_notes.note: UK DJ and Knee Deep In Sound boss Daley Padley; sophisticated deep and tech-house with a warm, soulful spine — a natural pairing with Chris Lake.

404a1190c380.event_note: Chris Lake at LASHP is a proper outdoor rave under the palm trees — the kind of night where the production is serious and the crowd comes to dance, not just attend. Hot Since 82 as support makes this a full package for the tech-house faithful.

artist_notes.name: Cassian
artist_notes.note: Australian producer, Grammy-winning mixer on RÜFÜS DU SOL's 'Alive' — dark-but-dreamy melodic house; the marquee draw here.

artist_notes.name: Kamino
artist_notes.note: London/LA/Brooklyn house & tech-house producer; broke out with 'Lower Frequency,' melody-forward but dancefloor-aimed.

2f0dfdae90af.curator_note: Day Trip's daytime melodic-house format in the park, anchored by Cassian — the more emotional, Afterlife-leaning counterweight to the Lake tech-house weekend if peak-time isn't your mood.
2f0dfdae90af.description: Day Trip In The Park daytime melodic/progressive-house party at LA State Historic Park with Cassian, Kamino, Millero and LUMI.

artist_notes.name: Richie Hawtin
artist_notes.note: Windsor/Detroit-Berlin minimal-techno icon (Plastikman, F.U.S.E.; founder of Plus 8 and M_nus) — a defining name in stripped, hypnotic techno. A tracked name; this is a free art-context set, not a club. (Cached.)

artist_notes.name: john gerrard
artist_notes.note: Irish artist behind LACMA's year-long browser-based 'SPIRITS' artwork; this solstice event is its Summer (Mediterranean) activation — gerrard appears alongside Hawtin. (Cached.)

deede894fa33.curator_note: A free summer-solstice dance at LACMA pairing Richie Hawtin with John Gerrard's 'SPIRITS' artwork — Hawtin in a museum-plaza art context rather than a club, so expect something more textural and hypnotic than a peak-time techno hammer. Worth it for the name and the setting; RSVP required.
deede894fa33.description: Free summer-solstice dance at LACMA with a techno set from Richie Hawtin, tied to artist john gerrard's 'SPIRITS' installation.

artist_notes.name: Dave Harrington
artist_notes.note: Half of Darkside (with Nicolas Jaar) and a fixture of LA's improv scene — guitar/electronics-led psychedelic jams; this is his quintet.

artist_notes.name: John Dwyer
artist_notes.note: Frontman of Oh Sees / Osees — prolific garage-psych and experimental bandleader (Castle Face Records), here in a free-improv setting.

artist_notes.name: Spencer Zahn
artist_notes.note: Composer and double-bassist working in ambient-jazz and modern-classical textures (collaborations with Dawn Richard among others).

artist_notes.name: Aaron Steele
artist_notes.note: LA/Nashville drummer-percussionist (Chrome Sparks and others) — versatile, jazz-fusion-leaning player.

artist_notes.name: Tom Dolas
artist_notes.note: Keyboardist in Oh Sees and Mr. Elevator — psych and jazz-fusion-flavored synth and keys.

e00ad8085b0c.curator_note: A one-off improvising quintet built around Dave Harrington (Darkside) and Oh Sees' John Dwyer at Zebulon — heady, psych-leaning instrumental jamming rather than songs. Squarely in the experimental-band lane Ari wants surfaced, and Zebulon's the perfect room for it.
e00ad8085b0c.description: One-night improvising quintet — Dave Harrington (Darkside), John Dwyer (Oh Sees), Aaron Steele, Spencer Zahn and Tom Dolas — at Zebulon in Frogtown.

52241f8a3d48.title: HARD Summer Music Festival Day 2

artist_notes.name: Amelie Lens
artist_notes.note: Antwerp-based techno powerhouse and Lenske founder; hard-driving, trance-tinged techno with massive festival energy.

artist_notes.name: Andy C
artist_notes.note: Drum and bass legend and Ram Records founder; the double-drop technique, the catalog, the energy — still unmatched.

artist_notes.name: Boys Noize
artist_notes.note: Berlin electro-techno producer and Boysnoize Records boss; production credits across hip-hop and electronic with consistently hard-hitting DJ sets.

artist_notes.name: DJ Snake
artist_notes.note: French producer whose trap-inflected EDM crossover hits are built for mainstages.

artist_notes.name: Frost Children
artist_notes.note: NYC sibling duo making hyperpop and experimental club music with an irreverent, maximalist aesthetic.

artist_notes.name: Knock2
artist_notes.note: American DJ/producer known for punchy, high-energy house and tech-house that has been a staple of the younger festival circuit.

artist_notes.name: Vintage Culture
artist_notes.note: Brazilian DJ/producer with silky, melodic tech-house that commands mainstages globally.

artist_notes.name: VTSS
artist_notes.note: Polish DJ/producer Marta Brauner; aggressive, fast-paced techno and EBM crossing underground credibility with festival reach.

artist_notes.name: Zedd
artist_notes.note: Grammy-winning Russian-German producer; progressive house and electro-pop crossover hits.

52241f8a3d48.event_note: Day 2 of HARD Summer skews slightly harder and more diverse — Amelie Lens and Andy C anchoring the techno and D&B ends while Frost Children and Underscores bring the hyperpop contingent. The full two-day experience is worth it if budget allows; Day 2 alone works if the lineup speaks to you.

bb4f346b7a87.title: Day Trip Festival Long Beach

artist_notes.name: Adam Beyer
artist_notes.note: Swedish techno don and Drumcode founder; metronomic, powerful techno that has been defining the sound of the genre for 25 years.

artist_notes.name: Cloonee
artist_notes.note: UK DJ/producer whose house and tech-house tracks have become DJ tools for the upper tier of the circuit — lean, functional, effective.

artist_notes.name: Elderbrook
artist_notes.note: British singer-songwriter and producer whose soulful, voice-forward electronic tracks have crossed over to mainstream festival audiences.

artist_notes.name: Hayden James
artist_notes.note: Australian DJ/producer making melodic, anthemic house that sits squarely in the feel-good lane — reliable warm-weather festival fare.

artist_notes.name: Hi-Lo
artist_notes.note: Oliver Heldens' alias for harder, darker techno and tech-house — stripped of the mainstream gloss of his main project.

artist_notes.name: Loco Dice
artist_notes.note: Tunisian-German DJ and Desolat label boss; raw, percussive tech-house and techno with a serious underground pedigree.

artist_notes.name: Sidepiece
artist_notes.note: Project from Nitti Gritti and Party Favor; punchy, fun tech-house that has been filling festival sets and Beatport charts.

artist_notes.name: Westend
artist_notes.note: Brooklyn-based house producer making groove-forward, sample-flipping club tracks that have found a home across the tech-house and deep house world.

bb4f346b7a87.event_note: Day Trip brings its curated outdoor-festival format to the Queen Mary grounds in Long Beach — deep and tech house focus with a few harder names mixed in, making it a more taste-forward alternative to the mega-festival circuit. Queen Mary's waterfront setting adds to the vibe.

9ea5376be5a4.title: Lights Down Low feat Yaeji

artist_notes.name: Yaeji
artist_notes.note: Korean-American DJ, producer, and vocalist whose smoky half-whispered vocals over minimal house and techno created an entirely new aesthetic — critically acclaimed, deeply individual, and endlessly influential on a generation of producers.

9ea5376be5a4.event_note: Lights Down Low is one of LA's premier underground queer and club-art events; landing Yaeji as headliner makes this a marquee night — expect a dark, immersive atmosphere where the music and the crowd are both doing something interesting.

d535a0dbfe40.title: Factory 93 presents: Amelie Lens at Grand Park Block 2

artist_notes.name: Amelie Lens
artist_notes.note: Antwerp-based techno powerhouse and founder of Lenske label; hard-driving, trance-tinged techno with massive festival energy — one of the most consistent headliners in the global techno circuit.

d535a0dbfe40.event_note: Factory 93's Block 2 outdoor events in Grand Park have become a signature LA techno institution — DTLA's skyline as the backdrop, serious production, and a booker with genuine underground credibility. Amelie Lens here is a strong pull for anyone who caught HARD Summer and wants more.

5d39cca0d4fb.title: In The Warehouse (Unofficial Chris Lake Afters)
5d39cca0d4fb.event_note: Unofficial after-hours warehouse event following the Chris Lake show at LASHP — the move if you want to extend the night into a darker, rawer setting after the main event wraps. DTLA warehouse parties run long; arrive knowing that.

9dca7cc7cf27.title: Hot Since 82

artist_notes.name: Hot Since 82
artist_notes.note: UK DJ and Knee Deep In Sound label boss Daley Padley; warm, sophisticated deep and tech-house with a soulful backbone — one of the most reliable selectors in the current circuit.

9dca7cc7cf27.event_note: A sunset-to-evening rooftop set (4:30-9pm) from Hot Since 82 at the Dream Hotel Hollywood — the day-party version of what he does at night, fitting the funky, deep-house end of his sound perfectly. Good option to warm up before the Chris Lake show or as a standalone golden-hour move.

58579f941eb8.title: Dirty Epic and INCOGNITO present: Stacey Pullen, BAE BAE and Nish

artist_notes.name: Stacey Pullen
artist_notes.note: Detroit techno and house veteran and KMS Records artist; a direct link to the Belleville Three lineage — soulful, deep, and groovy with the kind of musicality that separates Detroit from everywhere else.

58579f941eb8.event_note: Dirty Epic and INCOGNITO are among the more credible underground promoters working in LA right now — booking Stacey Pullen signals this is a serious room for people who know the history. Expect deep, soulful techno and Detroit-influenced house.

241179720c5f.title: Robert Hood, Disco Zombie, Onyx, & Rubbermiro

artist_notes.name: Robert Hood
artist_notes.note: Detroit techno pioneer, Underground Resistance founding member, and creator of the minimal techno blueprint — M-Plant label boss whose stripped-down, spiritual approach to techno is one of the genre's foundational texts.

241179720c5f.event_note: Same event as the WORK Robert Hood night listed from RA — techno, minimal, acid, running 11pm-6am. The late-night warehouse format suits Hood's austere, hypnotic sets perfectly. July 4th fireworks into Detroit techno is a legitimate LA tradition.

7e00f46a7221.title: Jayda G

artist_notes.name: Jayda G
artist_notes.note: Vancouver-born, Berlin-based DJ and producer whose joyful, disco-inflected deep house — rooted in her background as an environmental chemist and her love of soul and Black music history — makes her one of the most beloved figures in contemporary dance music.

7e00f46a7221.event_note: Jayda G at Sound is a feel-good, inclusive dance night leaning into the disco and deep house end of her catalog — a warm counterpoint to the harder techno options on July 4th weekend. Sound's intimate room suits her.

e667ba3ea44d.title: LA DISCOTECA
e667ba3ea44d.event_note: Free dance night at The Slipper Clutch in DTLA — LA DISCOTECA runs a dance-forward, disco-influenced format in one of the city's reliable underground venues. Free entry makes it an easy add to a busy June 26th.

a2ec0d8dd081.title: CSW and SLINK - Enayet and K Wata [All Night]
a2ec0d8dd081.event_note: CSW and SLINK are credible underground promoters in the LA scene; Enayet and K Wata going all-night is the format for serious selector-heads who want an extended, cohesive journey rather than a rotating bill.

4b5718ac6609.title: MARBLE: Halo Varga, Dylan Payne, Hazy, PabloDiscobar

artist_notes.name: Halo Varga
artist_notes.note: LA-based DJ and producer with a deep, tech-inflected house sound and strong roots in the city's underground circuit — a reliable headliner for taste-forward nights in the Arts District.

4b5718ac6609.event_note: MARBLE is an Arts District underground night with a solid reputation for booking LA's deeper house and techno selectors — Halo Varga headlining with a stacked local support bill makes this the right option for staying close to home on a busy weekend.

fd9f6e2edd10.title: Flying Mojito Bros, Brainstory

artist_notes.name: Flying Mojito Bros
artist_notes.note: Desert-psychedelic house duo with a distinctive sun-baked, Balearic-meets-Mojave aesthetic — regulars at Desert Daze and the Another Planet circuit, beloved for their analog warmth.

artist_notes.name: Brainstory
artist_notes.note: LA-based three-piece making hazy, soulful funk and R&B that sits somewhere between Shuggie Otis and 70s Motown — a deeply local band with a serious cult following.

fd9f6e2edd10.event_note: An unusual and appealing pairing at The Bellwether's intimate Camille's room — Flying Mojito Bros' desert-disco house alongside Brainstory's live psychedelic soul. The Another Planet / Desert Daze vibe in a compact venue setting.

039b68263b20.title: Stacey Pullen, Bae Bae and Nish

artist_notes.name: Stacey Pullen
artist_notes.note: Detroit techno and house veteran and KMS Records artist; a direct link to the Belleville Three lineage — soulful, deep, and groovy with the musicality that defines Detroit's approach to the genre.

039b68263b20.event_note: Same event as the Dirty Epic / INCOGNITO listing from a different source — Stacey Pullen headlining a tech house and techno night with local support. The Detroit connection makes this a standout booking for a June 26th packed with options.

da4e3fe70e19.title: discostan

artist_notes.name: discostan
artist_notes.note: LA-based DJ and cultural curator Arshia Haidari; discostan is both his alias and his club night, known for weaving together South Asian, Middle Eastern, and global disco and dance music into sets of genuine depth and political resonance.

da4e3fe70e19.event_note: Discostan at El Cid is a Silver Lake institution — globally minded, culturally specific dance music in an intimate room. Arshia Haidari's curation spans continents and decades without ever losing the thread; Kohinoorgasm adds another layer of South Asian club music perspective.

4d5f11e375f5.title: Butterground: Pocari G, Ashtre, Costa, Oso Disco, Blaze Claze
4d5f11e375f5.event_note: Butterground is an LA underground house night rotating through DTLA spaces — deep house focus with a local cast of selectors. The format favors groove and community over production spectacle; good option for a low-key Saturday.

c272d34d687c.curator_note: No lineup posted yet, which is half the point with Inland Groove — they keep it TBA until the last minute and the crowd self-selects accordingly. A solid late-Friday option if you're already out and nothing else has a hold on you.
c272d34d687c.description: Late-night after-hours house party in DTLA by the Inland Groove crew, 11pm-5am, free before 1am or $10.

f4fe507771f1.curator_note: No lineup visible on the DICE page, so 'house and hits' is all there is to go on — Gold Diggers is a reliably good room, but without a name attached this is a late-decide.
f4fe507771f1.description: Late-night house-and-hits dance party at Gold Diggers in East Hollywood, 10:30pm.

artist_notes.name: GG (5)
artist_notes.note: Billing format suggests a resident or small crew rather than a named solo artist — couldn't verify a public profile for 'GG (5)' specifically; included per the RA listing.

00bfe8a0d235.curator_note: Townhouse is a quirky Venice spot and the scoring hit on 'Ame' seems like a false positive from the text — no confirmed tracked artist here. Fine for a Westside late-night, not worth the drive from Silver Lake on faith alone.
00bfe8a0d235.description: Late-night electronic night at Townhouse in Venice, 10pm.

artist_notes.name: Ginger Root
artist_notes.note: Huntington Beach-born project led by Cameron Lew — City Pop-influenced synth-pop, alt-disco and boogie that splits the difference between '70s Japanese pop and American soul. His album SHINBANGUMI (Ghostly, 2024) is a polished, groove-first statement. This is a DJ set, not the full live show.

c56c321b3412.curator_note: Ginger Root spinning a DJ set at Bellwether's new Camille's room is a fun left-field free Friday — expect the City Pop / disco / boogie end of his record shelf rather than a live performance. Low-stakes but genuinely good taste.
c56c321b3412.description: Ginger Root (Cameron Lew, Ghostly International) plays a DJ set of City Pop, boogie, and disco at Camille's at The Bellwether, DTLA, 8pm-2am, free.

d26b1c2aec3d.curator_note: Gold Diggers' twice-monthly disco residency on a 4th of July Saturday — the room is intimate, the format is reliable, and you're not competing with a stadium crowd. Good fallback if the bigger Independence Day options feel exhausting.
d26b1c2aec3d.description: First-and-third-Saturday disco party at Gold Diggers in East Hollywood, 10:30pm.

artist_notes.name: Eli Escobar
artist_notes.note: NYC DJ/producer with 20+ years on the city's house and disco circuit — co-founder of Tiki Disco, Night People NYC label, resident at Le Bain and Battlehymn. His sets move through soulful New York house, boogie edits, and classic disco with a dancefloor-first sensibility rather than a crate-nerd lean.

9412d5b2209e.curator_note: Midnight Lovers flying Eli Escobar in for a July 4th TBA party is a solid booking — he's more accessible than the Euro-underground crowd but carries genuine New York house pedigree. Worth the $22 if the location drops somewhere good.
9412d5b2209e.description: Midnight Lovers presents NYC house and disco DJ Eli Escobar at a TBA DTLA location, 7pm-2am, $22 advance.

9fd90f37b8e7.curator_note: The Redwood Bar is a pirate-themed rock bar in DTLA — 'The Roamers' reads as a band or DJ collective but there's no verified lineup or genre info attached. Not enough signal to recommend without more detail.
9fd90f37b8e7.description: Electronic event 'The Roamers' at The Redwood Bar and Grill in DTLA, 8pm.

artist_notes.name: Porter Robinson
artist_notes.note: Household name — skip detailed annotation.

artist_notes.name: Dabin
artist_notes.note: Korean-Canadian melodic bass and future-bass producer, known for emotive guitar-laced electronic productions on Ophelia Records.

artist_notes.name: Louis the Child
artist_notes.note: Chicago electronic duo, known for feel-good indie-pop-adjacent electronic; major streaming numbers.

artist_notes.name: Audien
artist_notes.note: Connecticut-born melodic trance/progressive producer with Anjunabeats ties.

artist_notes.name: What So Not
artist_notes.note: Australian electronic producer (ex-Flume collaborator) spanning trap-influenced bass music and melodic club sounds.

5b8636a94da3.curator_note: Lost in Dreams leans heavily melodic-bass and future-bass rather than house or techno — it's the emotional-EDM festival end of the spectrum, not a club-culture pick. The Spotify boost for Porter Robinson explains the score, but this is a different crowd than the scene you usually want.
5b8636a94da3.description: Lost in Dreams Festival at LA State Historic Park with Porter Robinson, Dabin, Louis the Child, Audien, What So Not, ARMNHMR, and William Black.

artist_notes.name: Taylor Shockley
artist_notes.note: LA-based electronic DJ with a deep-listening, low-key aesthetic — ambient, minimal, dub and house sets that prioritize texture and mood over peak-time hammering. Active on RA and the LA underground circuit; this is exactly the record-nerd end of the scene.

artist_notes.name: Luke Mele
artist_notes.note: LA selector, part of the Information crew — limited public footprint outside the party circuit, included per the billing.

artist_notes.name: CHOÍCE
artist_notes.note: LA DJ affiliated with the Information all-vinyl series — couldn't verify a full public bio; included per the billing.

9a0fd9893571.curator_note: Information runs one of the more earnest all-vinyl concepts in DTLA — no CDJs, no filler, just a rotating cast of selectors taking the format seriously in a TBA location that keeps the room small and committed. Taylor Shockley headlining tips this toward the ambient/minimal-leaning end of vinyl culture rather than a disco or house crowd.
9a0fd9893571.description: Information's all-vinyl electronic night at a TBA Downtown LA location with Taylor Shockley, Luke Mele, and CHOÍCE, 10pm.

artist_notes.name: Demuir
artist_notes.note: Toronto-based DJ/producer and creator of the 'Jackin House' genre designation on Beatport — releases on Hot Creations, Desolat, Fool's Gold, and his own Purveyor Underground label. His sound fuses funk, soul and groove into a driving, underground house that skews more soulful than the tech-house crowd.

0eb89ce23c2b.curator_note: Certified Groovers consistently books sharp underground house names at their TBA DTLA warehouse — this is the Demuir who plays Hot Creations parties, not a tech-house imitator. Strong late-summer booking for the groove-and-soul end of the lane.
0eb89ce23c2b.description: Certified Groovers underground house party at a TBA Downtown LA location with Toronto DJ/producer Demuir, 10pm.

artist_notes.name: Massimiliano Pagliara
artist_notes.note: Italian-born, Berlin-based DJ/producer (Puglia-roots, 20+ years in the game) — records on Live at Robert Johnson, Ostgut Ton, and Permanent Vacation; runs his own Funnuvojere Records imprint. His sound is the soft-and-tender Berlin underground at its most precise: Italo flickers, emotive Balearic warmth, and outsider house. Celebrating 20 years of production with a 2026 LP of unreleased works.

artist_notes.name: Masha Mar
artist_notes.note: Serbian-born, LA-based DJ/curator (the Midnight Lovers crew) with NTS and Dublab residencies — Italo disco, house and dancefloor edits. (Cached.)

artist_notes.name: James Axon
artist_notes.note: LA-based selector and Midnight Lovers affiliate — limited verified public profile; included per the billing.

8a862e604d08.curator_note: Pagliara is exactly the kind of player the European-underground end of this taste wants: Ostgut Ton-stamped, permanently-vacation-energy, emotionally-charged house that holds a dancefloor without ever shouting. Getting him at The Bridge on a Thursday is a quiet coup for the Midnight Lovers crew.
8a862e604d08.description: Midnight Lovers presents Berlin-based Italian DJ Massimiliano Pagliara alongside Masha Mar and James Axon at The Bridge in DTLA, 9pm.

artist_notes.name: Gene On Earth
artist_notes.note: California-born (Redwood City), Berlin-based DJ/producer who runs the Limousine Dream label — deep, minimal house, techy rollers, hazy breaks and what he calls 'bullfrog techno.' Extended open-to-close sets are his format; think unhurried, late-night, all-consuming rather than peak-time anthem drops.

3061917831bd.curator_note: Gene On Earth all night long at a Certified Groovers TBA warehouse is a late-September pick worth marking now — Limousine Dream is one of the more consistent minimal-house labels running, and his open-to-close format makes the room feel earned by the time the sun comes up.
3061917831bd.description: Certified Groovers presents Berlin/California-based Gene On Earth for an all-night set at a TBA Downtown LA warehouse, 10pm.

50e6547bec06.curator_note: Vidiots in Eagle Rock is the rep cinema you want to support — the 1951 Vincente Minnelli/Gene Kelly MGM musical is gorgeous on a big screen, best known for its 17-minute abstract ballet finale. A nice daytime matinee if the weekend's overloaded with late nights.
50e6547bec06.description: Repertory screening of Vincente Minnelli's 'An American in Paris' (1951, Gene Kelly, Leslie Caron) at Vidiots in Eagle Rock, 1pm.

artist_notes.name: JTJ
artist_notes.note: LA-based tech-house and minimal selector, part of the Recollect Underground crew — active on the DTLA underground circuit, limited verified public profile.

artist_notes.name: Kenny Cordeiro
artist_notes.note: LA DJ in the deep-house and minimal space, Recollect Underground affiliate — couldn't find a verified label home but active in the same DTLA underground circuit.

artist_notes.name: Matt Marauder
artist_notes.note: LA selector running the tech-house to minimal range — included per the billing, limited verified bio.

1e27960536ad.curator_note: Recollect Underground keeps it tight: TBA address, $11-23 tickets, and a local crew running tech-house to minimal b2b sets through the pre-dawn hours. Not a headliner night but a properly curated underground one — the kind where the vibe is self-selecting.
1e27960536ad.description: Recollect Underground presents JTJ, Kenny Cordeiro, Matt Marauder, and two b2b pairs (Lavenge/Xuliet and Mama J/Max Rush) at a TBA DTLA location, 11pm-5am, $11.50-23.

artist_notes.name: Stavros Halkias
artist_notes.note: Greek-American stand-up from Baltimore, now NYC-based — two specials on Netflix (Fat Rascal) and a debut special 'Live at the Lodge Room' that cracked 7M views; also stars in Netflix's 'Tires.' His Stavvy's World podcast has a massive following. One of your listed favorites; this tour has already played Radio City Music Hall.

c0b91fb54504.curator_note: Stavros at the Wiltern on a Friday is exactly the comedy exception that makes the cut — his Fat Rascal special has been running on heavy rotation for good reason, and this tour is selling out theaters across the country. A great Friday if you want to laugh hard instead of dance hard.
c0b91fb54504.description: Stavros Halkias brings The Dreamboat Tour to The Wiltern in Koreatown for a Friday night stand-up set, 7pm.

artist_notes.name: Casmalia
artist_notes.note: LA-based house producer and DJ (Insomniac, mau5trap, Night Bass, CUFF) — her 'Unicorns Only' monthly is her own party brand; bass-driven groove-forward house with a West Coast festival edge. 2025 Coachella and EDC alum; her track 'Don't Tell Me How To Rave' hit #1 trending on SoundCloud in the US.

31d6a23bb826.curator_note: The Sunset Sessions series hands the Friday Level 8 rooftop to Casmalia's own Unicorns Only concept — part guest-takeover, part rooftop pool rave rather than the usual rotating-residents format. She's more festival-facing than the typical Sunset Sessions vibe, so expect more energy and less digger chill.
31d6a23bb826.description: Sunset Sessions Friday rooftop at Level 8 DTLA taken over by Casmalia's Unicorns Only concept — house and tech-house from 5pm, free entry.

artist_notes.name: JKriv
artist_notes.note: Co-founder of Brooklyn's Razor-N-Tape label (150+ releases since 2012) alongside Aaron Dae — trained jazz musician turned disco/house selector and producer, resident at The Lot Radio NYC. His sets weave eclectic disco, deep house, and off-kilter edits with genuine harmonic sense; the label has released Dimitri from Paris, Felipe Gordon, and Midnight Magic among others.

437b015f697a.curator_note: JKriv at Bar Franca free on a Friday is a no-excuse night — Razor-N-Tape is one of the few disco-edits labels that genuinely holds its quality across 150+ releases, and he brings the record knowledge to match. Silver Lake, free, late start: hard to argue with that combination.
437b015f697a.description: Midnight Lovers presents Brooklyn's JKriv (Razor-N-Tape) at Bar Franca in Silver Lake for a free Friday night set, 9pm.

aacf17a0f1c8.curator_note: A nostalgia night for peak-LMFAO era pop-EDM — this is exactly the '2010s decade night' category that earns a penalty in the taste profile. Skip unless irony is the mood.
aacf17a0f1c8.description: 2010-2015 pop and EDM nostalgia night at Catch One in Mid-City, 9pm, free with RSVP before 10:30pm.

artist_notes.name: Green Velvet
artist_notes.note: Chicago house and techno legend (Curtis Jones, a.k.a. Cajmere) — founder of Cajual and Relief Records in 1991/1992, pioneering acid-inflected, vocally quirky house and techno classics ('La La Land,' 'Flash,' 'Preacher Man'). One of the original architects of Chicago's underground sound; still touring hard and commanding rooms.

artist_notes.name: Ugo Banchi
artist_notes.note: French/Italian DJ and producer — debut on Diynamic (Solomun's label) with 'Dance With Ibiza' in 2023; sets range across melodic techno, progressive house, and Ibiza-leaning electronica. A newer name with European club pedigree but limited catalog depth so far.

7c349f4a2cfe.curator_note: Green Velvet headlining the Day Trip preparty at Exchange LA the night before the festival is a strong booking — he's a Chicago legend, not a festival cash-grab, and Exchange's room suits his driving acid-and-techno style. The $45-95 ticket is steep for a preparty, but the artist justifies it if you're not already going to Day Trip SoCal.
7c349f4a2cfe.description: Day Trip Festival SoCal preparty at Exchange LA with Chicago house/techno legend Green Velvet and French-Italian melodic selector Ugo Banchi, 10pm, $45-95.

dj nuts.note: Sao Paulo crate-digger revered for his Brazilian/global-beats edits (Wax Poetics 'Cultura Copia' mixtapes) — deep, eclectic, all-vinyl selector.

cut chemist.note: LA turntablist, ex-Jurassic 5 / Ozomatli — sample-collage funk and breaks; a foundational figure in the city's beats scene.

waajeed.note: Detroit producer/DJ (Bling47, Dirt Tech Reck) and Slum Village affiliate — soulful house and beats that bridge Dilla's lineage into the dancefloor.

shdw.note: Co-founder of the Mutual Rytm label and half of German duo SHDW & Obscure Shape — driving, hypnotic, melodic-leaning techno; squarely the refined European end you like.

bradley zero.note: Founder of Peckham's Rhythm Section International and the long-running NTS show — a genuine tastemaker selector spanning disco, broken beat, deep house and global grooves. One of the better daytime sets you can catch in LA this weekend.

masha mar.note: Serbian-born, LA-based DJ/curator (the Midnight Lovers crew) with NTS and Dublab residencies — Italo disco, house and dancefloor edits.

neeko.note: Resident selector for Sunday Sessions LA, the vinyl-only series at Apotheke — all-wax house and disco.

krane.note: Longtime Sunday Sessions LA resident — vinyl-only house DJ recorded across the series' open-air sets.

ayybo.note: Rising US tech-house producer, big-room festival energy — exactly the mainstream-fun end of the lane, not noise.

ragie ban.note: Brazilian house producer signed to Lake's own Black Book; their flip 'Toxic' hit Beatport #1.

dj minx.note: Detroit house matriarch, Women on Wax founder — tracked artist; deep, soulful, dancefloor-first selection.

josh caffé.note: London house vocalist/DJ and Paranoid London frontman; Black queer club energy with records on Crosstown Rebels and Classic — proper fabric-lineage stuff.

farralone.note: LA disco/house selector — couldn't verify a label home, but the billing reads classic nu-disco-into-house warmth.

trovarsi.note: LA modular/live techno artist and educator (SoCal Synth Society) — bassy, hardware-driven sets that swing from pounding to melodic.

e m bae.note: Part of the Black Techno Matters collective lineup; couldn't verify a full bio, so taking that at face value.

92jelani.note: Black Techno Matters-affiliated DJ; limited public footprint, included per the billing.

hot since 82.note: UK house heavyweight, Knee Deep In Sound boss — tracked artist; rolling, hypnotic, extended-set sensibility that elevates the whole bill.

claude vonstroke.note: Dirtybird founder (aka Barclay Crenshaw) — playful, bass-heavy West Coast house; he's billed leading the 'Team USA' set here.

ardalan.note: Tehran-born, Bay Area-raised Dirtybird mainstay — hypnotic, deep-bass house out of the Sunset Sound System lineage.

todd edwards.note: New Jersey UK-garage legend ('God of Garage') who shaped Daft Punk's sound — chopped-vocal, skippy house.

cut snake.note: Australian house duo (Sedz & Leigh Sedley) — sunny, festival-ready CRSSD-circuit house.

falcons.note: LA producer/DJ working the club-and-bass-leaning end; included per the bill.

ak chamel the giver of illness.note: Anonymous Houston duo doing desert-scorched ritual-folk and lo-fi psychedelia — masked, costumed, occult live show; fits the Zebulon experimental lane more than the dance one.

derek monypeny.note: Joshua Tree guitarist/oud + shahi baaja player (ex-Sir Richard Bishop's Freak of Araby Ensemble) — drone-to-free-jazz 'desert continuum' soundscapes.

xica soul.note: LA DJ and radio host (Artform, KQBH) — soul, funk and house, an In Sheep's Clothing-circuit selector.

cassian.note: Australian producer, Grammy-winning mixer on RÜFÜS DU SOL's 'Alive' — dark-but-dreamy melodic house; the marquee draw here.

kamino.note: London/LA/Brooklyn house & tech-house producer; broke out with 'Lower Frequency,' melody-forward but dancefloor-aimed.

eddie c.note: Canadian-in-Berlin slo-mo disco-edits heavyweight (Edward Currelly) — lush, dubby, generous grooves on Endless Flight; runs the 7 Inches of Love imprint with The Mole. A tracked name and a perfect open-to-close selector.

b wade.note: Resident behind the recurring 'Acts of Service Sounds' soulful-house night at Gold Diggers — 'sounds for the soul, all night long,' classic vocal/gospel-tinged deep house.

lydo.note: NYC-based, BASEMENT resident and X-TRA.SERVICES founder — fast, syncopated, heady techno-trance from the queer underground.

frankie teardrop.note: Montreal DJ/curator (Slut Island festival, LIP party) — high-energy queer-underground techno and rave.

tamara lanza.note: LA multi-genre DJ and Level 8 / Sunset Sessions regular — ranges disco house through deep and melodic; reliable rooftop-groove selector.

antal.note: Rush Hour co-founder, Amsterdam — one of the deepest diggers alive; obscure disco, raw house, broken beat and beyond. Flying in for this. A tracked name.

reverberation radio.note: The Allah-Las' long-running weekly podcast and DJ crew — deep-crate '60s-onward psych, surf, folk-rock, soul and global obscurities played off the records (Calico Discos label).

richie hawtin.note: Windsor/Detroit-Berlin minimal-techno icon (Plastikman, F.U.S.E.; founder of Plus 8 and M_nus) — a defining name in stripped, hypnotic techno. A tracked name; this is a free art-context set, not a club.

john gerrard.note: Irish artist behind LACMA's year-long browser-based 'SPIRITS' artwork; this solstice event is its Summer (Mediterranean) activation — gerrard appears alongside Hawtin.

dave harrington.note: Half of Darkside (with Nicolas Jaar) and a fixture of LA's improv scene — guitar/electronics-led psychedelic jams; this is his quintet.

john dwyer.note: Frontman of Oh Sees / Osees — prolific garage-psych and experimental bandleader (Castle Face Records), here in a free-improv setting.

spencer zahn.note: Composer and double-bassist working in ambient-jazz and modern-classical textures (collaborations with Dawn Richard among others).

aaron steele.note: LA/Nashville drummer-percussionist (Chrome Sparks and others) — versatile, jazz-fusion-leaning player.

tom dolas.note: Keyboardist in Oh Sees and Mr. Elevator — psych and jazz-fusion-flavored synth and keys.

charlotte de witte.note: Belgian techno titan known for relentless, hypnotic dark techno sets — one of the most in-demand DJ/producers in the world right now, co-runs KNTXT label.

amelie lens.note: Antwerp-based techno powerhouse and founder of Lenske label; hard-driving, trance-tinged techno with massive festival energy.

andy c.note: Drum and bass legend and Ram Records founder; his double-drop mixing technique is still unmatched after 30+ years in the game.

boys noize.note: Berlin producer/DJ (Boysnoize Records) whose electro-inflected techno and production credits (Daft Punk, Santigold) make him a reliable festival headliner.

brutalismus 3000.note: Vienna duo making abrasive, speed-inflected rave music at the nexus of EBM, hard techno, and industrial — one of the more exciting acts to emerge in recent years.

dj seinfeld.note: Swedish producer Armand Jakobsson; lo-fi, warm deep house with an emotional core — the bedroom-house aesthetic that launched a thousand imitators but the original still hits hardest.

dj snake.note: French producer and Interscope hitmaker who straddles trap, EDM, and global bass; festival-grade crowd-pleaser with genuine production chops.

maceo plex.note: Eric Estornel's alias for deeper, Detroit-influenced techno and dark house; respected across underground and festival circuits alike.

mau p.note: Dutch DJ/producer riding a massive wave with peak-time tech-house that has been dominating mainstages and Beatport charts.

rl grime.note: LA-born producer whose bass-heavy trap-influenced sets are a HARD Summer staple; dark, cinematic, hard-hitting.

shygirl.note: London rapper/singer blending hyperpop, R&B, and club music; critically acclaimed and one of the more interesting crossover artists in the PC Music orbit.

tiga.note: Montreal DJ and Turbo Recordings boss; a dry, sardonic electro-house sound that has been reliably great since the early 2000s.

tokischa.note: Dominican rapper and queer icon merging dembow, reggaeton, and art-world provocation; signed to Columbia with collaborations with Rosalia and Bad Bunny.

vintage culture.note: Brazilian DJ/producer with silky, melodic tech-house that commands mainstages globally; one of the biggest names coming out of Brazil's electronic scene.

vtss.note: Polish DJ/producer Marta Brauner; aggressive, fast-paced techno and EBM that has become a festival staple in both underground and crossover spaces.

zedd.note: Grammy-winning Russian-German producer; progressive house and electro-pop crossover hits that still destroy festival mainstages.

adam beyer.note: Swedish techno don and Drumcode founder; metronomic, powerful techno that has been defining the sound of the genre for 25 years.

cloonee.note: UK DJ/producer whose house and tech-house tracks have become DJ tools for the upper tier of the circuit — lean, functional, effective.

elderbrook.note: British singer-songwriter and producer whose soulful, voice-forward electronic tracks have crossed over to mainstream festival audiences.

hayden james.note: Australian DJ/producer making melodic, anthemic house that sits squarely in the feel-good lane — reliable warm-weather festival fare.

hi lo.note: Oliver Heldens' alias for harder, darker techno and tech-house — stripped of the mainstream gloss of his main project.

loco dice.note: Tunisian-German DJ and Desolat label boss; raw, percussive tech-house and techno with a serious underground pedigree.

sidepiece.note: Project from Nitti Gritti and Party Favor; punchy, fun tech-house that has been filling festival sets and Beatport charts.

westend.note: Brooklyn-based house producer making groove-forward, sample-flipping club tracks that have found a home across the tech-house and deep house world.

yaeji.note: Korean-American DJ, producer, and vocalist whose smoky half-whispered vocals over minimal house and techno created an entirely new aesthetic — critically acclaimed, deeply individual, and endlessly influential on a generation of producers.

stacey pullen.note: Detroit techno and house veteran and KMS Records artist; a direct link to the Belleville Three lineage — soulful, deep, and groovy with the kind of musicality that separates Detroit from everywhere else.

robert hood.note: Detroit techno pioneer, Underground Resistance founding member, and creator of the minimal techno blueprint — M-Plant label boss whose stripped-down, spiritual approach to techno is one of the genre's foundational texts.

jayda g.note: Vancouver-born, Berlin-based DJ and producer whose joyful, disco-inflected deep house — rooted in her background as an environmental chemist and her love of soul and Black music history — makes her one of the most beloved figures in contemporary dance music.

frost children.note: NYC sibling duo making hyperpop and experimental club music with an irreverent, maximalist aesthetic.

knock2.note: American DJ/producer known for punchy, high-energy house and tech-house that has been a staple of the younger festival circuit.

halo varga.note: LA-based DJ and producer with a deep, tech-inflected house sound and strong roots in the city's underground circuit — a reliable headliner for taste-forward nights in the Arts District.

flying mojito bros.note: Desert-psychedelic house duo with a distinctive sun-baked, Balearic-meets-Mojave aesthetic — regulars at Desert Daze and the Another Planet circuit, beloved for their analog warmth.

brainstory.note: LA-based three-piece making hazy, soulful funk and R&B that sits somewhere between Shuggie Otis and 70s Motown — a deeply local band with a serious cult following.

discostan.note: LA-based DJ and cultural curator Arshia Haidari; discostan is both his alias and his club night, known for weaving together South Asian, Middle Eastern, and global disco and dance music into sets of genuine depth and political resonance.

gg 5.note: Billing format suggests a resident or small crew rather than a named solo artist — couldn't verify a public profile for 'GG (5)' specifically; included per the RA listing.

ginger root.note: Huntington Beach-born project led by Cameron Lew — City Pop-influenced synth-pop, alt-disco and boogie that splits the difference between '70s Japanese pop and American soul. His album SHINBANGUMI (Ghostly, 2024) is a polished, groove-first statement. This is a DJ set, not the full live show.

eli escobar.note: NYC DJ/producer with 20+ years on the city's house and disco circuit — co-founder of Tiki Disco, Night People NYC label, resident at Le Bain and Battlehymn. His sets move through soulful New York house, boogie edits, and classic disco with a dancefloor-first sensibility rather than a crate-nerd lean.

dabin.note: Korean-Canadian melodic bass and future-bass producer, known for emotive guitar-laced electronic productions on Ophelia Records.

louis the child.note: Chicago electronic duo, known for feel-good indie-pop-adjacent electronic; major streaming numbers.

audien.note: Connecticut-born melodic trance/progressive producer with Anjunabeats ties.

what so not.note: Australian electronic producer (ex-Flume collaborator) spanning trap-influenced bass music and melodic club sounds.

taylor shockley.note: LA-based electronic DJ with a deep-listening, low-key aesthetic — ambient, minimal, dub and house sets that prioritize texture and mood over peak-time hammering. Active on RA and the LA underground circuit; this is exactly the record-nerd end of the scene.

luke mele.note: LA selector, part of the Information crew — limited public footprint outside the party circuit, included per the billing.

choíce.note: LA DJ affiliated with the Information all-vinyl series — couldn't verify a full public bio; included per the billing.

demuir.note: Toronto-based DJ/producer and creator of the 'Jackin House' genre designation on Beatport — releases on Hot Creations, Desolat, Fool's Gold, and his own Purveyor Underground label. His sound fuses funk, soul and groove into a driving, underground house that skews more soulful than the tech-house crowd.

massimiliano pagliara.note: Italian-born, Berlin-based DJ/producer (Puglia-roots, 20+ years in the game) — records on Live at Robert Johnson, Ostgut Ton, and Permanent Vacation; runs his own Funnuvojere Records imprint. His sound is the soft-and-tender Berlin underground at its most precise: Italo flickers, emotive Balearic warmth, and outsider house. Celebrating 20 years of production with a 2026 LP of unreleased works.

james axon.note: LA-based selector and Midnight Lovers affiliate — limited verified public profile; included per the billing.

gene on earth.note: California-born (Redwood City), Berlin-based DJ/producer who runs the Limousine Dream label — deep, minimal house, techy rollers, hazy breaks and what he calls 'bullfrog techno.' Extended open-to-close sets are his format; think unhurried, late-night, all-consuming rather than peak-time anthem drops.

jtj.note: LA-based tech-house and minimal selector, part of the Recollect Underground crew — active on the DTLA underground circuit, limited verified public profile.

kenny cordeiro.note: LA DJ in the deep-house and minimal space, Recollect Underground affiliate — couldn't find a verified label home but active in the same DTLA underground circuit.

matt marauder.note: LA selector running the tech-house to minimal range — included per the billing, limited verified bio.

stavros halkias.note: Greek-American stand-up from Baltimore, now NYC-based — two specials on Netflix (Fat Rascal) and a debut special 'Live at the Lodge Room' that cracked 7M views; also stars in Netflix's 'Tires.' His Stavvy's World podcast has a massive following. One of your listed favorites; this tour has already played Radio City Music Hall.

casmalia.note: LA-based house producer and DJ (Insomniac, mau5trap, Night Bass, CUFF) — her 'Unicorns Only' monthly is her own party brand; bass-driven groove-forward house with a West Coast festival edge. 2025 Coachella and EDC alum; her track 'Don't Tell Me How To Rave' hit #1 trending on SoundCloud in the US.

jkriv.note: Co-founder of Brooklyn's Razor-N-Tape label (150+ releases since 2012) alongside Aaron Dae — trained jazz musician turned disco/house selector and producer, resident at The Lot Radio NYC. His sets weave eclectic disco, deep house, and off-kilter edits with genuine harmonic sense; the label has released Dimitri from Paris, Felipe Gordon, and Midnight Magic among others.

green velvet.note: Chicago house and techno legend (Curtis Jones, a.k.a. Cajmere) — founder of Cajual and Relief Records in 1991/1992, pioneering acid-inflected, vocally quirky house and techno classics ('La La Land,' 'Flash,' 'Preacher Man'). One of the original architects of Chicago's underground sound; still touring hard and commanding rooms.

ugo banchi.note: French/Italian DJ and producer — debut on Diynamic (Solomun's label) with 'Dance With Ibiza' in 2023; sets range across melodic techno, progressive house, and Ibiza-leaning electronica. A newer name with European club pedigree but limited catalog depth so far.

chris lake.note: British-born, LA-based DJ/producer whose Black Book Records output — slippery, groove-heavy tech-house with a dark edge — has made him one of the defining figures of the current moment in American club music.
